item.title: Comcast NBC Universal Foundation Awards $30,000 Grant to Charleston Learning Center to Support Digital Literacy
item.description: The Comcast NBCUniversal Foundation has awarded a $30,000 grant to the CDC Education Foundation in support of its Digital Literacy Program, reinforcing a shared commitment to expanding access to technology skills and digital equity in Charleston

item.title: Dead Rabbit–Backed Charleston Tavern Project Scrapped
item.description: The yearslong effort to bring a community tavern from the team behind New York’s The Dead Rabbit to 549 King St. has come to a dispiriting close.

item.title: Labor & Delivery Unit at HCA Healthcare Colleton Hospital starts 2026 as one of U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals for Maternity Care
item.description: HCA Healthcare Colleton Hospital is proud to announce that its Labor & Delivery Unit will begin the new year as one U.S. News & World Report’s best hospitals for maternity care.

item.title: What Circumstances Commonly Surround Claims of Medical Malpractice
item.description: Medical malpractice claims rarely arise from a single bad moment. More often, they reflect a chain of decisions, delays, and documentation gaps that add up to patient harm. Understanding the patterns can help patients and providers spot risk earlier and reduce the chance of injury.

item.title: How to Design High Quality Team Gear for the Upcoming Season
item.description: Designing team gear is part art, part logistics, and part rulebook. Great uniforms look sharp, move well, and hold up to long seasons. This guide walks you through the big choices so your squad feels confident and game-ready when the whistle blows.

item.title: South Carolina Skates by Greenville, 5-3
item.description: In their seventh meeting this season, the South Carolina Stingrays scored four-unanswered goals across the 2nd and 3rd period to blow past the Greenville Swamp Rabbits, 5-3, on Wednesday evening at the Bon Secours Wellness Arena in Greenville

item.title: Bank Of America's "Museums On Us" Program Offering Free Admission to IAAM and Gibbes Museums This Weekend
item.description: Bank of America, Merrill, and Bank of America Private Bank cardholders can receive free general admission to two of Charleston’s cultural attractions - The International African American Museum (IAAM) and Gibbes Museum of Art this weekend

item.title: Country Star Luke Bryan Rings in the New Year Around Charleston
item.description: Country music singer-songwriter and American Idol host Luke Bryan is ringing in the new year in the Holy City.

item.title: Best Pre-Rolls: Your Go-to Guide for Flavor, Potency, and Convenience
item.description: You sit down after a long day, ready to unwind and relax. Then it hits you; you have to roll your joints. The bud leaks, and the papers tear. Let’s not even mention the rolling itself. Your joints might end up looking like a small crumpled scroll from an ancient civilization. Very frustrating, right? We understand you. And we are here to offer a solution: the best pre-rolls.

item.title: Galpão Gaucho Brazilian Steakhouse Marks 10 Years with Yearlong Group Dining Celebration
item.description: Galpão Gaucho Brazilian Steakhouse is celebrating 10 years since opening its Napa Valley location with a yearlong group dining promotion honoring the spirit of gathering that defines the brand.
